title: Snake's Impossible Pack
description: The Impossible Datapack adds dozens of incredibly difficult advancements and upgrade challenges that will test even the most dedicated Minecraft players.
body:
### **Snake's Impossible Pack**
Impossible Datapack adds dozens of extremely difficult and unique advancements and challenges designed for players who have already completed Minecraft and are looking for an even greater challenge.

From obtaining blocks that are normally impossible to acquire in Survival mode, such as Command Blocks, Spawners, and Structure Blocks, to completing unusual tasks and achieving absurdly rare objectives, this datapack will put your knowledge, patience, creativity, and determination to the test.

Features:
- 50+ custom advancements
- Extremely difficult and rare challenges
- Exploration-based objectives
- Progression-focused advancement trees
- Hidden advancements to discover
- Vanilla-friendly gameplay
- Multiplayer compatible

Examples of Challenges:
- Withered Time - Spawn a Wither from Spawn Egg in every biome
- The World of Trains - Place 100 Minecarts with Command Block on Rails
- It's Absolutely Enought - Place 1000 Vaults, Spawners and Trial Spawners
- Complete the Impossible Challenges
- Achieve seemingly impossible goals

Compatibility:
- Minecraft Java Edition 26.1+
- Singleplayer and Multiplayer
- No mods and Datapacks required

Are you ready to complete the impossible?
